summary: PROVEN (documented): alpine-based images use musl libc (postgres:17-alpine, node:*-alpine, gateway). No glibc-dependent native modules observed in the gateway image (sharp is a repo dependency but is NOT installed in the image - verified 'Cannot find module'). musl is therefore the only libc in play. Applies to 'qdrant/qdrant:v1.7.0 @ sha256:ff1639878418c0572f50a7e13'.
followup: Owner: if a glibc-linked native module is ever added, switch that image to a -slim (glibc) base.
